PixelBridge / Native Windows launcher

Your games.
Your screen.
One launchpad.

Bring Xbox Cloud Gaming, NVIDIA GeForce NOW, and your own legally sourced local games and media into a focused launchpad. PixelBridge is a native Windows WinForms app designed to stay lightweight, with a dark mint-and-cyan interface, controller-friendly navigation, and direct-HDMI TV setup in every tier.

Compare planned editionsUnderstand the streaming setup

A launcher, not a cloud provider

Cloud servicesXbox Cloud Gaming / GeForce NOW

Launch the provider's service. Its account, subscription, availability, and terms still apply.

Your Windows PCLocal games and media

Your PC runs the emulator or media app. You supply the software and content you have the right to use.

Your other screenDirect HDMI or Sunshine to Moonlight

Connect your Windows PC directly to a TV, or configure a Sunshine host and Moonlight client for local-network streaming.

Choose the destination

One place to start. Your services stay yours.

Cloud

Launch existing services

Open Xbox Cloud Gaming or NVIDIA GeForce NOW. PixelBridge does not provide independent cloud rendering or include a service subscription.

Local

Bring your own library

Start local emulation or media tools with content you may legally use. No games, ROMs, BIOS files, or keys are bundled.

Catalog

Official emulator routes

The planned curated catalog covers NES, SNES, Sega Genesis / Mega Drive, Dreamcast, and N64, linking to official emulator projects rather than game downloads. Final entries await app confirmation.

Control

Mappings in every edition

All usable Xbox controller mappings and standard importable profiles are included in every edition. Basic controller input is never a paid unlock.

Choose the connection

Go direct by HDMI. Or stream over your LAN.

Direct HDMI / every tier

Your PC, connected to your TV

Connect the Windows PC's HDMI output to your TV. Setup uses supported native Windows display and audio settings and guidance, without a Sunshine video encode/decode path. This is not automatic TV firmware control or a promise of unsupported display modes.

Local content runs on your PC. Xbox Cloud Gaming and GeForce NOW still have their provider and internet latency when your PC is connected by HDMI.

Local-network streaming

Sunshine host, Moonlight client

Run local content on your Windows PC, install Sunshine separately, and connect a compatible Moonlight client on your receiving device. Planned customer-friendly onboarding and diagnostics guide the LAN setup; PixelBridge does not replace either project.

No router WAN port forwarding or UPnP is required for this LAN setup. Your hardware, network, client, and content determine the experience.

No blanket compatibility or latency promise: v1.2.0 is planned for Windows x64, but final supported Windows versions, prerequisites, and production-release testing are not confirmed here. PixelBridge does not promise zero lag or support for every TV, streaming stick, controller, HDMI mode, or game.

Same input access. Different conveniences.

Controller support is not the upgrade.

Included in every tier: all usable Xbox controller mappings, standard importable profiles, and direct-HDMI TV output/setup using supported native Windows display and audio settings and guidance. Pro is for advanced editable and saved profile variants and their import/export, not for standard controller configuration or basic HDMI setup.

This is the approved edition direction, pending confirmation against the final app. Paid prices, checkout routes, and delivery details have not been approved; none are offered here.

Free / no ads

Free

Xbox Cloud Gaming and GeForce NOW launching, basic manual emulator links and launching, plus the mappings and standard profiles included in every tier.

Free / affiliate-supported

Free with Ads

Adds a curated catalog and saved launcher entries, with modest disclosed AdGuard affiliate banners on relevant app menu pages only. No click is required and no banner overlays gameplay.

Paid / ad-free

Supporter

Ad-free library conveniences, with the same usable controller mappings and standard profiles as Free. Final library details await app confirmation.

Paid / advanced profiles

Pro

Advanced editable and saved profile variants with import/export. All usable mappings and standard importable profiles remain available in every tier.

Affiliate disclosure: the Free with Ads app edition may show relevant AdGuard affiliate recommendations. Quasar Labs may receive compensation after a purchase through those links. Clicking is optional, and these app-only placements do not add advertising to the Quasar Labs website.

Verification without overclaiming

Provenance is not Windows reputation.

01 / Planned release signing

GitHub OIDC and Sigstore

The intended production signing method uses GitHub OIDC-backed Sigstore bundles. No PixelBridge production artifact or signature is claimed as verified in this draft.

02 / Exact bytes and identity

Verify the named release

Final instructions must pair each exact artifact with its SHA-256 checksum and bundle, and pin the actual certificate identity and issuer. Those release-specific values are not guessed here.

03 / Different trust systems

No Authenticode claim

Sigstore verification checks signed bytes and workflow identity. It does not make an EXE Windows Authenticode-signed, establish Microsoft SmartScreen trust, or guarantee safety or compatibility.

Independent software. Clear boundaries.

PixelBridge is a Quasar Labs app, not a licensed, endorsed, or affiliated Nintendo, Sega, Xbox, or NVIDIA product. Service names and trademarks belong to their respective owners. You supply your own accounts, subscriptions, software, and legally sourced content, subject to the relevant terms and local law.

No games, ROMs, BIOS files, or keys are bundled. The public distribution repository is for release delivery, not public app source.
